title: Introduction To Respiratory Anatomy & Physiology
description: Anatomy of the respiratory system, ventilation, diffusion of pulmonary gases, circulatory system, and oxygen transport. Intended for students in the Respiratory Therapy Program; enrollment is limited to students accepted in the program.
outcomes: Describe the alveolar capillary membrane and gas diffusion.
State the structure of the upper and lower airways.
objectives: State the structure of the upper airways.
State the structure of the lower airways.
Name and locate the bronchopulmonary segments.
Relate the action of the respiratory muscles to rib, thoracic movement and pleural pressures.
Describe the alveolar capillary membrane and gas diffusion.
Diagram the pulmonary, systemic, and bronchial circulation.
Locate and name the large arteries and veins in the adult.
content: Action of the respiratory muscles in relation to rib, thoracic movement and pleural pressures
Alveolar capillary membrane and gas diffusion
